[h1] TL;DR [/h1] Great game, but very buggy. I can see myself coming back to play whenever i'm bored or have time to spare. -- That being said, it's very buggy. Like i found myself coming across a lot off issues but nothing TOO game breaking. Kinda.

[b]Pros:[/b] 
[list]
[*]Good soundtrack. 
[*]Beautiful pixel-art, overall visually pleasing.
[*]Random enemies and boss encounters.
[*]Very addicting and sometimes very challenging.
[*]Can customize both Controller and K+M keybindings. 
[*]Different unlockable classes/(tools?) making the game filled with a lot off replayability. 
[*]Reasonably cheap. 
[*]Includes COOP. (Not tried it yet)
[*]Three different difficulties, (Easy, Normal & Hardcore)
[*]Download size is very small, took me 2 minutes to download.
[/list]
[b]Cons:[/b]
[list] 
[*]VERY buggy, 
[i]Like keys being stuck, making you seamlessly attack. 
A.I sometimes cannot jump over normal obstacles.[/i] 
[spoiler] Got a boss to be stuck on a flying platform, he would not jump down until i blasted him to death.. [/spoiler]
[*]Although the replayability is there, it sometimes get very repetetive, especially early on when you're still new to the game.
[*]You have to put time and effort into unlocking new classes (This is both good and bad)
[*]Screenshot key not working?
[*]Cannot assign keybindings to mouse
[*]Sometimes really unclear what you need to do to unlock new classes
[/list]
[i]You just kinda recieve an "achievement-like" message saying you did "this" and unlocked "that".[/i]

??????


Overall it's pretty nice, and not very expensive for what it offers, give it a try :thinking:

You need A LOT of spare time, some runs take 2-3 hours.

Very difficult, but plenty of fun. Took several tries before beating my first boss.
There are a variety of characters to unlock and play as, with very different playstyles, making thr game highly replayable.
Great solo or with friends.
Possibly my new favorite game.
